svg.title: Debts · Extra payments wireframe
svg.text: PLANS / PLAN FOR RETIREMENT / ASSETS & DEBTS
Dated extra payments shorten payoff and cut interest.
Payments stop automatically when the balance reaches zero.
A percentage-of-balance extra payment recalculates as the balance falls.
A $30,000 student loan at 6% with $333/month pays off in 2036. Adding $200/month moves payoff to 2031 and lowers
Extra payments are dated and repeat on a chosen frequency. The editor rejects an end date before the start date.
The comparison reads two backend results: baseline and modified. The UI does not model amortization.
Payments stop at a zero balance, and cash flow updates in that year.
